div.div: Web token: single use, valid 60 s, bound to the same user, issued only to the webgate's uid and accepted only from guacd's real address. The broker skips the RDP second factor because MFA was proven at Keycloak. No H.264 in the browser path; sessions get no Kerberos ticket. /web/approve needs a fresh MFA sign-in and shows the same login code as the RDP window; notifications carry no secret and link only to /web/approve.

text.tspan: Web token: single use, valid 60 s, bound to the same user, issued only to the webgate's uid and accepted only from guacd's real address. The broker skips the RDP second factor
because MFA was proven at Keycloak. No H.264 in the browser path; sessions get no Kerberos ticket. /web/approve needs a fresh MFA sign-in and shows the same login code as the RDP
window; notifications carry no secret and link only to /web/approve.
